data.name: Alonso
data.long_meaning: Alonso is a name of Hebrew origin, believed to have derived from the Hebrew name 'Eliazar', which means 'God is my help' or 'Elias', meaning 'My God is salvation'. In Christian tradition, the name is a reminder of God's assistance in times of need and the importance of relying on divine guidance. The name was also borne by Spanish explorer Alonso de Leon, who helped establish St. Augustine, Florida in 1565.

in_hebrew.name: אלונסו
in_hebrew.meaning: אלונסו הוא שם שמשמעותו אציל או מוכתר באצילות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלונסו הוא שם שמקורו בספרדית ומשמעותו אציל או מוכתר באצילות. השם אלונסו הוא גרסה ספרדית של השם אלפונסו, שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו מוכן ללחימה או אציל מוכן. השם אלפונסו היה נפוץ בקרב מלכים ואצילים בספרד ובפורטוגל במהלך ימי הביניים. מבחינה רוחנית, השם אלונסו מייצג אצילות, כוח וגדלות.

in_greek.name: Αλόνσο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλόνσο είναι μια ισπανική μορφή του ονόματος Αλφόνσο, το οποίο προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Alphonsus. Το όνομα αυτό σημαίνει Ευγενής ή Άριστος και ήταν δημοφιλές ανάμεσα σε βασιλιάδες και ευγενείς στην Ισπανία και την Πορτογαλία κατά τη διάρκεια του Μεσαίωνα. Το όνομα Αλόνσο συμβολίζει την ευγένεια, τη δύναμη και τη μεγαλοσύνη.

in_latin.name: Alonso
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alonso est forma hispanica nominis Alphonso, quod oritur ex latino nomine Alphonsus. Hoc nomen significat Nobilis or Generosus et fuit populare inter reges et nobiles in Hispania et Portugallia durante Medio Aevo. Spiritualiter, nomen Alonso repraesentat nobilitatem, fortitudinem et magnitudinem.

historical_references.reference: Alonso V of Castile, known as 'Alonso the Wise', ruled from 1474 to 1521. During his reign, he established the Casa de Contratación, the first permanent European institution dedicated to trade with the New World. He also supported the works of Christopher Columbus and sponsored the voyages of Ferdinand Magellan.

historical_references.reference: Alonso X, known as 'Alonso the Brave', ruled from 1252 to 1272. He was the last Christian ruler of the Moorish kingdom of Seville before it fell to the Castilians. Alonso X was also the first king of Castile and León to be crowned Emperor of the Romans by the Pope in 1257, conferring upon him the title 'Alonso the Emperor'.

modern_usage.modern_context: Alonso is a popular name of Spanish origin, often associated with three distinct modern contexts: Formula One racing, gaming, and television. In the world of Formula One, Alonso is synonymous with the Red Bull Racing team, which has featured two-time World Champion Fernando Alonso as one of its drivers since the 2015 season. The racing community continues to follow Alonso's career progress, building a strong fanbase. In the gaming industry, Alonso appears as a character in Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto V, adding to his broader cultural presence. Lastly, Alonso's name is recognized in the television industry, specifically in the context of Spanish football (LaLiga), where he previously played professionally for teams such as Real Sociedad and Deportivo La Coruña. Overall, Alonso's name resonates across these three platforms and is a testament to his multifaceted impact on modern culture.
